name: java-devbox-test1
description: Java development on any OS. Devbox installs everything, so this works the same on Linux, macOS and Windows (WSL2).

init_hook: test -x "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT/.keycloak/keycloak-$KEYCLOAK_VERSION/bin/kc.sh" || { echo "Downloading Keycloak $KEYCLOAK_VERSION (one-off, ~130 MB)..."; mkdir -p "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT/.keycloak"; curl -fL --progress-bar -o "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT/.keycloak/keycloak.zip" "https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/releases/download/$KEYCLOAK_VERSION/keycloak-$KEYCLOAK_VERSION.zip" && unzip -q "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT/.keycloak/keycloak.zip" -d "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT/.keycloak" && rm -f "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT/.keycloak/keycloak.zip" || echo 'Keycloak download failed. Check KEYCLOAK_VERSION in devbox.json.'; }

scripts.db-reset: test -n "$PGDATA" && rm -rf "$PGDATA" && echo 'Database deleted. Run: devbox services up'
scripts.kc-reset: rm -rf "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT/.keycloak/keycloak-$KEYCLOAK_VERSION/data" && echo 'Keycloak realms/users deleted. Run: devbox services restart keycloak'
scripts.kc-purge: rm -rf "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT/.keycloak" && echo 'Keycloak removed. Run: devbox shell'
